newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: VW to recall models made in Portugal.
newsitem.headline: VW to recall models made in Portugal.

text.p: German carmaker Volkswagen is recalling 21,600 Sharan multi-purpose vehicle models produced at Portugal's AutoEuropa plant and sold across Europe due to brake and door lock problems, a Volkswagen spokesman said on Thursday.
"Volkswagen is asking clients by letter to have their vehicles checked," Hector De Morais told Reuters.
He said Volkswagen was recalling 14,600 Sharan vehicles produced since September this year to check for possible problems with the brake pedal.
Another 7,000 would be checked for possible faults with the lubrication of door locks, he added.

Some Ford Galaxy models were affected by the same problems as they were also produced at the AutoEuropa factory at Palmela, south of Lisbon, the Volkswagen spokesman said. He did not know how many Ford Galaxy vehicles were affected.
Ford and AutoEuropa officials were not immediately available.
